source_frontmatter.name: blog-to-social
source_frontmatter.description: Convert a finished blog post into three ready-to-post social media versions in one pass for Facebook, X, and LinkedIn. Always trigger immediately when the user's message starts with "bts". Also trigger on "blog to social", "social posts for this", "promote this post", or when the user pastes or links a blog post and asks to share it, promote it, or turn it into social content.
